effect: The excavator cleared the surveyed bay, completing the chapter; the cavern still has no breathable air.
reaction: The distinction between shelter and breathable space was a satisfying, sensible closing detail.

mostWorthwhile.text: Clearing the bay was the most worthwhile passage: the drum, hopper and spoil pile made the work understandable, and the result established a plausible space for the growing room.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first attempted cable connection was least worthwhile: it produced a separator instead of helping prepare the excavator, with no immediate explanation of its purpose.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the unsuccessful cable-and-excavator attempt automatically made an electromagnet from the cable and steel.

arbitrary.text: Making the separator felt disconnected from the current excavation goal, even though the described electromagnet itself made physical sense.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how the cleared but airless bay becomes a growing room, especially if the next chapter continues explaining the practical work.
